title: Norbi's More achivements
body: This mod adds more achivements to minecraft. tired of normal boring advancements? this mod adds 20+ more achivements and chalenges such as: collecting every music disc, obtaining the mace, finding the hearth of the sea and much more. the mod loader is neoforge 1.21.8-11. use 1.21.8 for perfect experience. the mod is still in development so more updates are comming soon.
